name: PunisherBanna
overview: Zufällige Filme und Serien als Banner auf der Jellyfin-Startseite.
description: Zeigt zufällige Filme oder Serien aus einer ausgewählten Bibliothek als anklickbaren Banner-Slider an.

versions.changelog: Adds a persistent English/German language selector to the PunisherBanna settings page, with English as the default. All labels, descriptions, option values, live volume text, dependency status messages, and error dialogs switch immediately and the administrator's choice is saved in the plugin configuration.

Fixes primary-button navigation at the pointer-event level. Releasing the left mouse button after a normal banner press now opens the owning series or movie directly, without waiting for a browser-generated click that may be suppressed by pointer capture. Genuine drag gestures and all dedicated banner controls remain excluded.
